skill.name: gofact
skill.description: Creates compliant French electronic invoices locally. Takes an HTML invoice and structured data, produces a Factur-X file: a PDF/A-3 with the EN 16931 CII XML embedded byte for byte, self-checked against the EN 16931 rules before it is written. Legal invoice numbering — a continuous, gap-free, never-reused sequence — is held by the server in a locked registry, never by the language model: the model writes a `{{NUMERO}}` token and the server allocates the real number transactionally.
